reason: A DSH web client plugin that folds completed-turn process nodes into expandable summary rows while preserving final replies and user-controlled expanded state.

summaries.zh: 一个为 DSH Web 客户端自动折叠已完成对话轮次中间过程节点并提供可展开摘要行的界面布局插件。
summaries.en: A DSH web client layout plugin that automatically folds intermediate nodes in completed conversation turns into expandable summary rows.

capabilities: modifies chat interface visibility and layout
adds an expandable summary row for conversation turns
persists per-session expanded state in localStorage
